### Day 79: 1 Kings 1:1–4
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-79-1-kings-1-14.html
Passage: 1 Kings 1:1-4
Points:
- David's shivering and physical decline highlight the inescapable frailty and mortality of human life.
- Even mighty warriors and leaders of faith eventually face the end of their earthly vitality.
- A lifetime spent navigating severe emotional and spiritual extremes carries a heavy personal toll.
- When life moves through dramatic highs and lows, believers can ask God to meet them fully in every extreme.
